overview: Lesotho is a small landlocked kingdom completely surrounded by South Africa. Its capital and largest city is Maseru. Lesotho became independent from the United Kingdom in 1966. Sesotho and English are its official languages, and many people wear the traditional Basotho blanket and hat.

geography.text: Lesotho is the only country in the world that lies entirely above 1,000 metres, which has earned it the nickname 'Kingdom in the Sky'. Much of it is in the Maloti and Drakensberg mountains, and its highlands supply water to South Africa through large dams and tunnels.

subsections.title: Climate
subsections.text: Cold winters with snow in the mountains, warm summers.

subsections.title: Wildlife
subsections.text: Bearded vultures soar over the mountains.

history.text: King Moshoeshoe I united the Basotho people in the early 1800s from his mountain stronghold of Thaba Bosiu. To protect his land from Boer settlers he asked for British protection, and Basutoland became a British protectorate in 1868. Lesotho became independent in 1966. It is entirely surrounded by South Africa.

events.title: Thaba Bosiu
events.text: Moshoeshoe makes the mountain his stronghold.

events.title: Crisis
events.text: South African and Botswanan troops intervene after a disputed election.

government.text: Lesotho is a constitutional monarchy. The King is head of state, and the Prime Minister leads the government with the support of the elected National Assembly. The army has interfered in politics several times.

economy.text: Lesotho is surrounded by South Africa and closely linked to its economy. It sells water to South Africa through the Lesotho Highlands Water Project, and exports clothing and diamonds.

culture.text: Lesotho is called the 'Kingdom in the Sky': it is the only country entirely above 1,000 metres. The Basotho blanket and the conical mokorotlo hat are national symbols.

items.title: Basotho blanket
items.text: Worn as a cloak in the cool highlands.

items.title: Mokorotlo
items.text: A woven conical hat shown on the flag.

subsections.title: Traditions and festivals
subsections.text: Basotho blankets are given at important life events.

sport.text: Football is the most popular sport. Pony trekking is a way of life in the mountains, and Lesotho hosts the gruelling Roof of Africa motorbike race.

items.title: Roof of Africa
items.text: A hard enduro motorcycle race through the mountains.
